learning_outcomes.text: Student acquire knowledge about the criteria and methods for the proper use of tools, measuring equipment and devices for diagnostics, monitoring and automation of industrial mechanical systems.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of energetic concepts, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, and electrical engineering
Sizing of a pneumatic control valve.
Scheme of control of a mechanical plant
Mechanical plants controlled by two position
Industrial furnace: methane and gas supply line
assessment_rules: The final exam consists of a written and oral assessment. It aims at assessing the learning of the design methodology of mechanical industrial plants, with particular attention to regulation and control systems. The final test also evaluates the ability to define the main characteristics of control systems and instrumentation used in industrial plant engineering and the ability to apply the concepts with the definition of P&ID and electromechanical panels of industrial plants.
